Stranger at the Gate

A fine Benedict Koehler reel from Paddy O’Brien recording of the same name.

Another one of the Pigeon on the Gate/ Hut in the Bog family

↳ Posted by Thom Pratt on December 11th, 2005.

You must have a different Paddy O’Brien recording of the same name than the one I have! The tune Paddy plays (at least on my record :-) ) is in Gm and nothing like what you have posted.

I suspect Benedict may have composed it in Am. I’ll find out from him and transcribe either Paddy O’Brien’s setting, or Benedict’s, and post in due course.

Re: Stranger At The Gate

Did anyone ever figure out whether Paddy’s setting or the ones here are closer to Benedict Koehler’s original?

↳ Posted by Daniel Parker on August 1st, 2025.

Re: Stranger At The Gate

At first glance the Paddy O‘Brien version is nothing like any of the above, but it’s just the first four measures that trip us off. The rest is pretty much the same - not exactly the same notes (and not the same key either), but similar enough to be the same tune. I’d say that the opening phrase in the above settings (B2EF GBEG) is very pipe friendly, while Paddy O’Brien’s isn’t (even if we transpose his Gdor version to Edor).

↳ Posted by jeff_lindqvist on August 1st, 2025.
